maddeler.e:
اشترعوا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَعُوا (ištaraʕū) /iʃ.ta.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اُشْتُرِعُوا (ušturiʕū) /uʃ.tu.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اِشْتَرِعُوا (ištariʕū) /iʃ.ta.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
